# Introduction

Linear mixed-effects models are used to test whether Age and treatment (visit
timepoint) can affect protein biomarker levels, and whether there is an interaction of
age-treatment impact on protein biomarkers. FDR correction is applied across cytokines 
within each stimulation. A threshold of p < 0.05 is used to identify significant effects.

Figure 5B: Age and treatment effect on protein biomarkers across stimulation
conditions.

For each cytokine and stimulation condition a model of the form
`Cytokine_Value ~ Visit * Age + Sex + Arm + (1|ID1)` is fitted. The
interaction term tests whether the association between Age and cytokine level
differs between visits. All plots are saved regardless of significance.

# Define cytokine columns

meta_cols <- c("ID1", "Visit", "Condition", "Comments", "Age", "Sex", "Arm")

# Reshape to long format

Each row represents one cytokine measurement for one patient at one visit.

```{r}
data_long <- cytokine_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(cytokine_cols),
    names_to  = "Cytokine",
    values_to = "Cytokine_Value"
  )

cat(sprintf(
  "Rows: %d | Cytokines: %d | Patients: %d\n",
  nrow(data_long),
  n_distinct(data_long$Cytokine),
  n_distinct(data_long$ID1)
))
```

# LME screening function

`screen_lme`: fits `Cytokine_Value ~ Visit * Age + Sex + Arm + (1|ID1)` for
one cytokine and one stimulation condition. Returns Wald chi-square p-values
for the Visit main effect, Age main effect, and their interaction. Returns
NULL if data are insufficient.

```{r}
screen_lme <- function(data, cytokine_name,
                       stimulation  = NULL,
                       covariates   = NULL,
                       min_obs      = 10,
                       min_subjects = 5) {

  dat <- data %>%
    filter(
      Cytokine == cytokine_name,
      !is.na(Cytokine_Value),
      !is.na(Age)
    )

  if (!is.null(stimulation)) {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(Condition == stimulation)
  }

  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      ID1   = as.factor(ID1),
      Visit = factor(Visit, levels = c("W0", "W16", "W24", "W72"))
    )

  if (nrow(dat) < min_obs || n_distinct(dat$ID1) < min_subjects) return(NULL)

  covariate_terms <- if (!is.null(covariates)) paste(covariates, collapse = " + ") else NULL
  formula_str     <- paste(
    "Cytokine_Value ~ Visit * Age",
    if (!is.null(covariate_terms)) paste("+", covariate_terms),
    "+ (1|ID1)"
  )

  tryCatch({
    model     <- lmer(as.formula(formula_str), data = dat, REML = FALSE)
    anova_res <- Anova(model, type = 3)

    data.frame(
      Cytokine      = cytokine_name,
      Stimulation   = if (!is.null(stimulation)) stimulation else "All",
      Visit_p       = anova_res["Visit",     "Pr(>Chisq)"],
      Age_p         = anova_res["Age",       "Pr(>Chisq)"],
      Interaction_p = anova_res["Visit:Age", "Pr(>Chisq)"],
      N_obs         = nrow(dat),
      N_subjects    = n_distinct(dat$ID1),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("LME failed for ", cytokine_name, " | ", stimulation, ": ", e$message)
    NULL
  })
}
```

# P-value formatting helper

```{r}
format_p <- function(p) {
  stars <- if (p < 0.001) "***" else if (p < 0.01) "**" else if (p < 0.05) "*" else ""
  label <- if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else sprintf("p = %.3f", p)
  paste0(label, stars)
}
```

# LME plot function

`plot_lme`: fits the same model as `screen_lme` and generates a scatter plot
with LME-predicted regression lines per visit and 95% confidence bands from
emmeans, adjusted to the mean values of Sex and Arm. Raw p-values with
significance stars are shown in the subtitle. Regression equations per visit
and the covariate adjustment note are annotated in the top right corner.

```{r}
plot_lme <- function(data, cytokine_name,
                     visit_colors, stimulation = NULL,
                     covariates = NULL, save_path = NULL) {

  dat <- data %>%
    filter(
      Cytokine == cytokine_name,
      !is.na(Cytokine_Value),
      !is.na(Age)
    )

  if (!is.null(stimulation)) {
    dat <- dat %>% filter(Condition == stimulation)
  }

  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(
      ID1   = as.factor(ID1),
      Visit = factor(Visit, levels = c("W0", "W16", "W24", "W72"))
    )

  if (nrow(dat) < 10 || n_distinct(dat$ID1) < 5) return(invisible(NULL))

  covariate_terms <- if (!is.null(covariates)) paste(covariates, collapse = " + ") else NULL
  formula_str     <- paste(
    "Cytokine_Value ~ Visit * Age",
    if (!is.null(covariate_terms)) paste("+", covariate_terms),
    "+ (1|ID1)"
  )

  model <- tryCatch(
    lmer(as.formula(formula_str), data = dat, REML = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) return(invisible(NULL))

  anova_res     <- Anova(model, type = 3)
  visit_p       <- anova_res["Visit",     "Pr(>Chisq)"]
  age_p         <- anova_res["Age",       "Pr(>Chisq)"]
  interaction_p <- anova_res["Visit:Age", "Pr(>Chisq)"]

  age_seq <- seq(
    min(dat$Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(dat$Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 50
  )

  pred <- as.data.frame(
    emmeans(model, ~ Visit * Age,
            at = list(Age = age_seq))
  )

  coefs         <- fixef(model)
  intercept_w0  <- coefs["(Intercept)"]
  slope_w0      <- coefs["Age"]

  intercept_w16 <- intercept_w0 +
    ifelse("VisitW16" %in% names(coefs), coefs["VisitW16"], 0)
  slope_w16     <- slope_w0 +
    ifelse("VisitW16:Age" %in% names(coefs), coefs["VisitW16:Age"], 0)

  intercept_w24 <- intercept_w0 +
    ifelse("VisitW24" %in% names(coefs), coefs["VisitW24"], 0)
  slope_w24     <- slope_w0 +
    ifelse("VisitW24:Age" %in% names(coefs), coefs["VisitW24:Age"], 0)

  intercept_w72 <- intercept_w0 +
    ifelse("VisitW72" %in% names(coefs), coefs["VisitW72"], 0)
  slope_w72     <- slope_w0 +
    ifelse("VisitW72:Age" %in% names(coefs), coefs["VisitW72:Age"], 0)

  visits_present <- levels(droplevels(dat$Visit))

  eq_lines <- c()
  if ("W0"  %in% visits_present)
    eq_lines <- c(eq_lines, sprintf("W0:  y = %.3fx %s %.3f",
      slope_w0,  ifelse(intercept_w0  >= 0, "+", "-"), abs(intercept_w0)))
  if ("W16" %in% visits_present)
    eq_lines <- c(eq_lines, sprintf("W16: y = %.3fx %s %.3f",
      slope_w16, ifelse(intercept_w16 >= 0, "+", "-"), abs(intercept_w16)))
  if ("W24" %in% visits_present)
    eq_lines <- c(eq_lines, sprintf("W24: y = %.3fx %s %.3f",
      slope_w24, ifelse(intercept_w24 >= 0, "+", "-"), abs(intercept_w24)))
  if ("W72" %in% visits_present)
    eq_lines <- c(eq_lines, sprintf("W72: y = %.3fx %s %.3f",
      slope_w72, ifelse(intercept_w72 >= 0, "+", "-"), abs(intercept_w72)))

  eq_label   <- paste(eq_lines, collapse = "\n")
  stim_label <- if (!is.null(stimulation)) stimulation else "All conditions"
  x_unit     <- if (cytokine_name == "pan_IFNA") "log10 fg/mL" else "log10 pg/mL"

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = pred,
      aes(x = Age, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, fill = Visit),
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = pred,
      aes(x = Age, y = emmean, color = Visit),
      linewidth = 1.5
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = dat,
      aes(x = Age, y = Cytokine_Value, color = Visit),
      alpha = 0.6, size = 2.5
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = Inf, label = eq_label,
      hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.2,
      fontface = "italic", color = "gray30"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = visit_colors, name = "Visit") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = visit_colors, name = "Visit") +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(cytokine_name, "  (", stim_label, ")"),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Visit: ",       format_p(visit_p),       "  |  ",
        "Age: ",         format_p(age_p),          "  |  ",
        "Interaction: ", format_p(interaction_p)
      ),
      x       = "Age (years)",
      y       = paste0(cytokine_name, " (", x_unit, ")"),
      caption = paste0(
        "LME: Cytokine_Value ~ Visit * Age",
        if (!is.null(covariates)) paste0(" + ", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")),
        " + (1|ID1)"
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position     = "top",
      plot.title          = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle       = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray40"),
      panel.grid.major    = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.grid.minor    = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.2)
    )

  print(p)

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(
      file.path(save_path,
                paste0(cytokine_name, "_", stim_label, "_LME_Age.pdf")),
      plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in"
    )
  }

  invisible(p)
}
```

# Run all analyses

All cytokines are screened and plotted for each stimulation condition. FDR
correction is applied across cytokines within each stimulation. All plots are
saved regardless of significance.

```{r}
all_analyses <- list()
stimulations <- c("Null", "Mtb_Ag", "LPS", "IL1B")
covariates   <- c("Sex", "Arm")

for (stim in stimulations) {
  out_dir <- file.path(output_main, stim)
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  cat(sprintf("\nStimulation: %s\n", stim))

  screening_results <- bind_rows(lapply(cytokine_cols, function(cyt) {
    screen_lme(
      data          = data_long,
      cytokine_name = cyt,
      stimulation   = stim,
      covariates    = covariates,
      min_obs       = 10,
      min_subjects  = 5
    )
  }))

  if (nrow(screening_results) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("  No results for %s. Skipping.\n", stim))
    next
  }

  cat(sprintf("  Cytokines screened: %d\n", nrow(screening_results)))

  screening_results <- screening_results %>%
    mutate(
      Visit_p_adj       = p.adjust(Visit_p,       method = "fdr"),
      Age_p_adj         = p.adjust(Age_p,         method = "fdr"),
      Interaction_p_adj = p.adjust(Interaction_p, method = "fdr"),
      Visit_sig         = Visit_p_adj       < 0.05,
      Age_sig           = Age_p_adj         < 0.05,
      Interaction_sig   = Interaction_p_adj < 0.05,
      Any_sig           = Visit_sig | Age_sig | Interaction_sig
    ) %>%
    arrange(Interaction_p_adj)

  cat(sprintf(
    "  FDR-significant: Visit = %d | Age = %d | Interaction = %d\n",
    sum(screening_results$Visit_sig,       na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(screening_results$Age_sig,         na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(screening_results$Interaction_sig, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))

  write_xlsx(screening_results, file.path(out_dir, "LME_screening_results.xlsx"))

  for (cyt in cytokine_cols) {
    plot_lme(
      data          = data_long,
      cytokine_name = cyt,
      stimulation   = stim,
      visit_colors  = visit_colors,
      covariates    = covariates,
      save_path     = out_dir
    )
  }

  summary_table <- screening_results %>%
    select(
      Cytokine, Stimulation, N_obs, N_subjects,
      Visit_p, Visit_p_adj, Visit_sig,
      Age_p, Age_p_adj, Age_sig,
      Interaction_p, Interaction_p_adj, Interaction_sig, Any_sig
    )

  write_xlsx(summary_table, file.path(out_dir, "LME_summary_table.xlsx"))

  all_analyses[[stim]] <- list(
    screening_results = screening_results,
    cytokines_plotted = cytokine_cols
  )
}
```
